segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the 38-seat plan for the calibration tracking rollout and make sure the dates and billing look right before I send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. We counted again yesterday. It’s 32 regular users and 6 supervisors, all in the same plant. No need for the second site until next year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 38 total for the Cleveland plant only. The annual subscription is $28,500, and the one-time setup is $4,200. That includes the asset import for up to 1,800 gauges and the two admin training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On the invoice, can you split the setup fee from the subscription? Our finance team books those differently.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that’s standard. You’ll see two line items on the same invoice: $4,200 setup and $28,500 subscription. Net 30, starting from the effective date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Effective date should be September 1, not the signature date. We’re trying to align it with the maintenance budget.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: September 1 works. Term would run September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027. Go-live target is September 16, assuming we receive the asset file by September 5.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine. We can send the file on the 3rd. It’ll have gauge ID, location, due date, and last calibration result. Do you need owner name too?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Owner name is helpful but not required. If you include it, we’ll map it during import. Also, for the training, I have September 10 at 11 Central and September 12 at 2 Central available.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let’s do September 10 at 11. The supervisors can make that. I’ll have procurement review the order form, but the numbers and dates sound right to me.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send the order form with 38 seats, September 1 start, the split invoice line items, and the September 10 training slot. If procurement has edits to billing contact or PO language, send them back and we’ll update before signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Put me and Mark Chen on the email. Mark handles the PO, and I’ll confirm the asset file owner internally.
